source.path_note: Archived script still requests data/deor_poem.txt and pages/page_20/runes.txt. The poem is now in data/corpora; old page_20 is current LP2-03 by nonempty GP-rune length and SHA256.

input.page: Current text/lp2-03.txt, 217 GP29 runes, exactly matching pinned old pages/page_20/runes.txt after GP-rune filtering.
input.partition: Keep rune indices 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,23 (prime indices) as the 65-symbol prime stream. The remaining 152 are the nonprime stream. Preserve each subsequence's reading order.
input.deor: Use pinned deor-poem-source.txt exactly as the source parser does: split before the literal prefix DEOR POEM (MODERN ENGLISH, uppercase the older section, greedily parse TH/AE/NG/OE/EO/IO/EA and source ASCII letters. This yields 960 GP29 values; the first 600 offsets are eligible. See input-parser-amendment.json for the correction to the frozen initial plan.

original_source_procedure.first_stage: At each of 600 Deor offsets and each of beaufort/sub/add, decode all 65 prime-index ciphertext values and choose the maximum raw IoC, with source iteration order breaking ties.
original_source_procedure.second_stage: Repeat the selected 65-value plaintext as key. For each sub/add/beaufort and offset 0..64, decode the 152 nonprime values. Preserve source's best raw IoC and its impossible HIT comparison raw_ioc>1.3.
original_source_procedure.caesar_diagnostic: Try 29 modular shifts of the nonprime values. Preserve the original impossible raw_ioc>1.5 branch and calculate the common shift-invariant IoC.
original_source_procedure.gate_issue: Source ioc() is unnormalized Σf(f−1)/(N(N−1)), in [0,1]. Comparisons to 1.3 and 1.5 cannot pass for any input. Zero printed HIT rows therefore cannot be a negative finding.

separate_amended_diagnostic.metric: Report normalized IoC =29×raw IoC, without changing source decoders or selection. The source's second-stage 1.3 and Caesar 1.5 can then be interpreted as descriptive candidate screens, not validated decryption thresholds.
separate_amended_diagnostic.null: Run 199 seeded complete-page GP29 shuffles preserving the 217-rune histogram and recompute the complete prime/nonprime split, first-stage best selection and second-stage maximum. Seed 20261023. Compare whole-procedure maxima with the observed one; no per-variant cherry-picking.
separate_amended_diagnostic.positive: Use synthetic residue vectors to verify the three algebraic decoder signs, prime/nonprime partition lengths, exact Deor parser, 65-value key repetition and shift-invariant IoC. This checks implementation, not power to recognize English.

limits: One current LP2 page and one pinned Deor corpus under an unusual split-by-ciphertext-value assumption. First-stage best selection is adaptive. A corrected normalized-IoC comparison is a post-source diagnostic, not the original script's result. No claim about all split-stream or running-key ciphers.
